description.p: Draftside Companion observes an ESPN fantasy draft room already open in a dedicated local Chrome profile and securely relays normalized draft events to a private Draftside dashboard.
It never submits picks, changes league settings, or stores ESPN credentials. Reconnect recovery restores missed picks from ESPN's current draft board.

screenshot.caption: The private Draftside dashboard during a mock draft

description.p: Keeps ESPN's live draft room stable while reconnecting the read-only pick stream.
Recovers and follows live picks from ESPN's rendered draft store when no socket opens.
Distinguishes ESPN room detection from War Room board registration.

ul.li: Keeps the managed Chrome session open while dashboard requests retry.
Opens the selected private War Room automatically.

description.p: Stops the companion runtime and managed Chrome window when its status window closes.
Follows the open ESPN room, supports explicit draft selection, and recovers stream reconnects.
Corrects upgrade versioning and makes the companion strictly on demand.
Prompts for the dashboard URL, reports each connection stage, and runs only when opened.
Adds automatic laptop enrollment, dashboard revocation, and a native status window.
First portfolio-ready Ubuntu package with complete software-center metadata.
